input.description: Search one collection and get ranked hits back. Give query (text; the server embeds it for every field the collection binds an embedding to — with a dense and a sparse field bound, the dense field answers first and the sparse field is the automatic fallback) or queries (field name to vector, when you computed vectors yourself).

query.description: Query text for the collection's embedding-bound fields.

queries.description: Field name to vector: a dense float array, or a sparse {indices, values, dim} object. A schema field appears in vectors or is covered by text, never both.

score_floor.description: Confidence filter on raw scores. Direction follows the field metric: on dense (distance) fields keep score <= floor; on sparse/fused scores keep score >= floor. When set and nothing survives, the response says weak_match: true.

fallback.description: Auto-fallback ladder: search primary; if it is weak, answer from secondary and report fell_back_to.

usage_boost.description: Blend frecency into ranking (0 = off). Reported scores stay raw.

response_format.description: concise elides metadata strings over 300 chars.

max_chars.description: Result-size budget; tail hits are dropped over it and named in the hint.

filter.description: Metadata filter: {"field": value} for equality, {"field": {"$op": value}} with $op one of $eq, $ne, $gt, $gte, $lt, $lte, $in, $nin, $contains, $startswith, $endswith, $regex, $exists, $geo_radius, $geo_bbox, or one logical operator: {"$and": [f, ...]}, {"$or": [f, ...]}, {"$not": f}.

best_score.description: Best raw score among returned hits; 0 when none. Use it to calibrate score_floor.

score_direction.description: How to read score and best_score: dense fields return distances (lower_is_better), sparse and fused hybrid return scores (higher_is_better). Names the direction of the field that actually answered, so a fallback answer reports the secondary field's direction.

weak_match.description: true = score_floor was set and nothing survived it; treat as 'no confident answer'.

fell_back_to.description: Secondary field that answered when the fallback ladder fired.

embedded_by.description: Field name to 'provider:model' for query texts the server embedded.

hint.description: What to do next when truncated or weak.
